description: Recommends the safest narrow AI-human workflow to implement first, including roles, review rules, escalation rules, success metrics, and missing information.

aiIdea.description: AI or automation idea the user is considering.

bottlenecks.description: Known or suspected bottlenecks the first workflow should address.

businessType.description: Type of business, such as ecommerce, SaaS, consulting, agency, local service, or solo business.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as budget, team capacity, tools, timeline, compliance needs, or data access.

currentGoal.description: Current business goal the user wants the review to support.

currentProblem.description: Main business or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: How the relevant workflow currently works, including manual steps, tools, handoffs, and review points.

goal90Days.description: Desired business or workflow outcome over the next 90 days.

notes.description: Any additional context the user wants considered in the review.

offer.description: Core product, service, package, or outcome the business sells.

opportunities.description: AI opportunities already identified or under consideration.

revenueModel.description: How the business earns revenue, such as projects, retainers, subscriptions, services, or products.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns related to customer trust, brand reputation, legal exposure, sensitive data, or quality control.

risks.description: Known risks or control concerns that should shape the workflow design.

targetCustomer.description: Primary customer segment or buyer the business serves.

teamSize.description: Approximate team size and key roles involved in the workflow.

name: recommend_first_workflow

aiRole.description: What AI should observe, summarize, draft, classify, or prepare.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

escalationRule.description: Rule for cases that should escalate to a human owner or expert.

expectedOutcome.description: Expected business outcome if the workflow is piloted successfully.

firstImplementationScope.description: Smallest practical pilot scope for the first version.

humanRole.description: What a human should approve, decide, handle, or monitor.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve workflow recommendation confidence.

recommendedWorkflow.description: Narrow AI-human workflow recommended as the safest first implementation.

reviewRule.description: Rule for when human review is required before output or action.

successMetrics.description: Practical metrics to evaluate workflow pilot success.

whyThisWorkflow.description: Reason this workflow is a practical first candidate based on value, readiness, and risk.

workflowCategory.description: Category of workflow, such as sales prep, support triage, QA, reporting, or operations.

title: Recommend First Workflow
